modules.title: Faire connaissance
modules.goal: Introduce yourself, introduce others, and ask a follow-up.

modules.title: Le quotidien
modules.goal: Exchange routines, likes, and how often you do things.

modules.title: Tu ou vous ?
modules.goal: Pick the register, make small talk, ask to repeat, and switch to tu.

modules.title: Inviter
modules.goal: Invite to an apéro; accept or decline without offending.

modules.title: Fixer un rendez-vous
modules.goal: Agree on time, place, and people; move the plan.

modules.title: Au café
modules.goal: Order, specify, accept a substitute, and pay.

modules.title: Boulangerie et marché
modules.goal: Order bread and market food, ask quantities and prices, and say « c'est tout ».

modules.title: En boutique
modules.goal: Ask for an item, a size or a colour; try it on; pay; exchange or return it.

modules.title: Réserver
modules.goal: Book a table by phone, give your name, leave a message, confirm or change the booking.

modules.title: Se repérer
modules.goal: Give your address, guide a lost delivery driver by phone, and ask for and follow directions.

modules.title: Grève et retards
modules.goal: Understand a strike, a cancellation or a delay, and find another way to get there.

modules.title: Le logement
modules.goal: Report a broken boiler, a leak or lost keys, and arrange the repair with the landlady and the neighbours.

modules.title: Être en retard, annuler
modules.goal: Say you're late, apologise and explain, cancel or postpone, and propose a new plan.

modules.title: Santé
modules.goal: Describe a symptom, get advice at the pharmacy, make a doctor's appointment, and say you're ill or better.

modules.title: Ça ne marche pas
modules.goal: Complain politely about a parcel, a haircut or a bike repair, and ask for a fix.

modules.title: Raconter sa soirée
modules.goal: Tell what you did last night, in order, and say how it was.

modules.title: Une galère
modules.goal: React to a friend's bad-day story, sympathise, ask what happened and ask back.

modules.title: Comparer
modules.goal: Compare flats, phone plans and bikes: advantages, drawbacks and value for money.

modules.title: Choisir ensemble
modules.goal: Propose, compare options and negotiate a plan in the group chat, then confirm it and share the costs.

modules.title: Conseiller
modules.goal: Ask for and give advice: recommend an option with a reason, warn, and react to the choice.
